{{Quote|I am Lord Shaar. But please, call me&hellip; whatever you like.|Lord Shaar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Darth Shaar''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're dealing with Darth Shaar. She's the Dark Councillor in charge of Imperial logistics, which... doesn't sound very scary?''"<br />"''Maybe, but you don't make the Dark Council just by getting supplies delivered on time. Never underestimate a Sith.|[[Arn Peralun]] and [[Tau Idair]]|<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />}}
[[File:Shaar.png|thumb|left|200px|Shaar on Belsavis]]
A particularly passionate [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Shaar had a "vigorous" relationship with Lord [[Raxxus]] in her youth several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the Galactic War, though their relationship soured and the radical Sith was marked for [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Dark Council]] before Raxxus was captured by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Shaar learned that Raxxus was among the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and enlisted Imperial aid in eliminating her former lover.<ref name="TOR" />

Lord Shaar would continue her service to the Empire for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], even surviving the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Eternal Empire's invasion]] to the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. In that time, she became a [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] and operated freely within the Empire's [[Sphere of Civil Administration|civil administration]].<ref name="torweb181130">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181130|text=Jedi Under Siege: State of the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Lord Shaar was a crafty and hedonistic individual who excelled at the game of Sith politics, knowing how not to appear threatening and maintaining many contradictory alliances until ready to strike. She liked to savor physical and experiential luxuries provided by her position in the civil administration.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Darth Shaar}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Shaar appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where she provides Imperial players with the Heroic mission "Old Enemies."<ref name="TOR" /> Darth Shaar is voiced by Lucy Robinson.<ref name="Onslaught" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
For players that sided with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] on [[Iokath]] and killed [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]], Shaar is stated to have ascended to the [[Dark Council]] as an overseer of the [[Sphere of Civil Administration]], replacing [[Darth Vowrawn]] who would have become Emperor under these circumstances. Alternatively, if [[Jace Malcom]] is killed in Acina's place, then Shaar remains a Lord of the Sith.<ref name="TOR" />

====Onslaught====
====Supporting the Republic====
If the player supports the Republic in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion, they will meet Shaar at the [[Huttbreaker]]'s auction. In the aftermath of the Empire's attack on the [[Mek-Sha]] docks, [[Tau Idair]] notes that Shaar was missing and speculated that she either fled or was amongst the Imperial shuttles the Republic shot down.<ref name="Onslaught" />

====Supporting the Empire====
[[File:Death_of_Shaar_and_Vowrawn.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lana Beniko kills Darth Shaar and Darth Vowrawn.]]
If the player supports the Empire in the ''Onslaught'' expansion, Shaar will be the player's liaison throughout their operations on Mek-Sha.<ref name="Onslaught" /> If Acina is the Empress, Shaar will be accompanied by Darth Vowrawn. If Vowrawn is Emperor, then Shaar alone will direct the Commander. An Imperial Loyalist or Republic Saboteur player is given the opportunity to order [[Lana Beniko|Lana]] to kill Shaar (and Vowrawn if he's present) by [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitation]].

Imperial players have the option to flirt with her regardless of [[Gender/Legends|gender]], which she will seemingly reciprocate. If the player flirts with Major [[Anri]] after she changes her outfit, Shaar will agree with the player's sentiment, indicating an interest in the Major as well.<ref name="Onslaught" />
